description: Back-in-stock emails for customers, low-stock alerts for your team
name: Stock Alerts

highlights.title: Back-in-stock emails
highlights.description: Customers leave their email on a sold-out product and get one email with its image, price and link the moment it's restocked.

highlights.title: Low-stock alerts for your team
highlights.description: Admins get one email when a product drops to its threshold, and the alert resolves itself once stock is back above it.

highlights.title: A threshold for every product
highlights.description: Set a store-wide default, or give any product its own low-stock threshold on its Stock alerts tab.

highlights.title: Optional daily digest
highlights.description: One summary email each morning listing every product that is still running low.

highlights.title: Nothing else to connect
highlights.description: Runs on Swell's own product data and notifications, with no third-party service, account or API key to set up.

images.title: Stock Alerts for Swell
